oneLiner: A web app that turns what's already in your fridge into a full week of meals.
problem: People waste food and money because they don't know what to cook with what they already have, and planning meals from scratch each week feels tedious.
targetUser: Busy home cooks and budget-conscious households who want to reduce food waste and simplify weekly meal planning.
coreFlow: User inputs or scans items currently in their fridge/pantry
App suggests a 7-day meal plan using available ingredients, flagging a few items to buy
User swaps or adjusts suggested meals based on preference
App generates a consolidated shopping list for missing ingredients
User checks off meals as cooked throughout the week, updating fridge inventory

screens.name: Fridge Inventory
screens.purpose: Add, edit, or scan items currently in the fridge and pantry

screens.name: Weekly Plan
screens.purpose: View and adjust the generated 7-day meal plan

screens.name: Recipe Detail
screens.purpose: Show ingredients, steps, and substitutions for a selected meal

screens.name: Shopping List
screens.purpose: Display consolidated list of missing ingredients to buy

screens.name: Settings & Preferences
screens.purpose: Set dietary restrictions, household size, and cooking preferences

outOfScope: Social sharing or community recipe features
